ex.en: The scientists noticed an anomaly in the data.
ex.zh: 科學家注意到資料中有異常。

ex.en: A cold day in July is an anomaly here.
ex.zh: 七月出現冷天在這裡很反常。

anomaly.en: something that is different from what is normal or expected

ex.en: The announcer read the news in a calm voice.
ex.zh: 播報員用平靜的語氣播報新聞。

ex.en: The stadium announcer called out the players' names.
ex.zh: 球場播報員唸出球員的名字。

announcer.en: a person who reads the news or gives information on radio or television

ex.en: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
ex.zh: 他故意犯錯來惹我生氣。

ex.en: Waiting for too long makes most people annoyed.
ex.zh: 等太久會讓大多數人不耐煩。

ex.en: Meg sometimes annoys Ken.
ex.zh: 梅格有時會惹肯生氣。

ex.en: The Nobel Prize is awarded annually on December 10, the day of Alfred Nobel's death.
ex.zh: 諾貝爾獎每年在十二月十日頒發，那天是諾貝爾的忌日。

ex.en: The conference is held annually in Taipei.
ex.zh: 這場研討會每年在台北舉辦。

ex.en: The company reviews salaries annually.
ex.zh: 公司每年檢討一次薪資。

ex.en: You can call me anytime you like.
ex.zh: 你隨時都可以打電話給我。

ex.en: You can borrow my car anytime.
ex.zh: 你隨時可以借用我的車。

ex.en: I can start anytime.
ex.zh: 我隨時可以開始。

anytime.zh: anytime soon：（多用於否定）短期內

ex.en: I don't think this rain will let up anytime soon.
ex.zh: 我看這場雨短時間內不會停。

ex.en: Prices won't come down anytime soon.
ex.zh: 價格短期內不會降下來。

ex.en: He has an eye for antiques.
ex.zh: 他很有鑑賞古董的眼光。

ex.en: This chair is a valuable antique.
ex.zh: 這張椅子是很值錢的古董。

ex.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我最近的古董店在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
ex.zh: 他在古董店偶然發現了這枚舊硬幣。

ex.en: She collects antique furniture.
ex.zh: 她收藏古董家具。

ex.en: After the fire, they had to start anew.
ex.zh: 火災之後，他們必須從頭開始。

ex.en: Let's begin anew tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天重新開始吧。

ex.en: It's too late, anyhow.
ex.zh: 反正已經太晚了。

ex.en: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
ex.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

ex.en: Anyhow, let's get back to the main topic.
ex.zh: 總之，我們回到正題吧。

anyhow.en: used to say that something is true in any case, or to change the subject

ex.en: I'm not anti the plan; I just have some concerns.
ex.zh: 我不是反對這個計畫，只是有些疑慮。

ex.en: Most of the team are anti working on weekends.
ex.zh: 大部分組員都反對週末上班。

ex.en: She receives an annuity of 20,000 dollars a year.
ex.zh: 她每年領兩萬美元的年金。

ex.en: He bought an annuity to plan for retirement.
ex.zh: 他買了年金保險為退休做準備。

annuity.en: a fixed sum of money paid every year

ex.en: The purpose of antitrust law is to stop the abusive influence of the market by big companies.
ex.zh: 反壟斷法的目的，是防止大公司濫用對市場的影響力。

ex.en: The company is facing an antitrust investigation.
ex.zh: 這家公司正面臨反壟斷調查。

antitrust.en: against large companies controlling a market unfairly

ex.en: The job requires strong analytical skills.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要很強的分析能力。

ex.en: Amy has a very analytical mind.
ex.zh: Amy 的思考非常有條理、善於分析。

analytical.en: using careful study to understand something

ex.en: She has strong analytic skills.
ex.zh: 她的分析能力很強。

ex.en: We need a more analytic approach to the problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要用更有分析性的方法處理這個問題。

analytic.en: using careful study to understand something

any.zh: 任何的、一些（用於疑問句、否定句）

ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
ex.zh: 你知道銀行幾點關門嗎？

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 情況如有任何變化，請通知我。

any.en: used in questions and negative sentences to mean some or even one

ex.en: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
ex.zh: 她的英文說得比班上任何同學都好。

ex.en: If you need any, just ask me.
ex.zh: 如果你需要一些，跟我說就好。

any.en: one or some of a group, no matter which

ex.en: Mr Kato was too old to work any longer.
ex.zh: 加藤先生年紀太大，沒辦法再工作了。

ex.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了那個噪音了。

any.en: used to say that something has stopped

ex.en: I hear he's just begun looking for another job.
ex.zh: 聽說他剛開始找另一份工作。

ex.en: Can we meet another day?
ex.zh: 我們可以改天見面嗎？

another.en: different from the one you have or have mentioned

ex.en: I would like to have another cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 我想再來一杯咖啡。

ex.en: The boy reached out for another piece of cake.
ex.zh: 男孩伸手又拿了一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們最好再等三十分鐘。

another.en: one more of the same kind

ex.en: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.
ex.zh: 我有一支原子筆，但我還想再要一支。

ex.en: This cup is dirty. Can I have another?
ex.zh: 這個杯子髒了，可以再給我一個嗎？

another.en: one more of the same kind, or a different one

ex.en: A tiger is a very ferocious kind of animal.
ex.zh: 老虎是一種非常兇猛的動物。

ex.en: Humans are the only animals that can use fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會用火的動物。

ex.en: There are a lot of animals in the park.
ex.zh: 公園裡有好多動物。

animal.en: a living creature that is not a person or a plant

ex.en: I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
ex.zh: 我沒有 CD 播放器，但還是把 CD 買了。

ex.en: Everyone was against it, but Mary and John got married anyway.
ex.zh: 雖然大家都反對，瑪麗和約翰還是結婚了。

ex.en: Anyway, you'll never know.
ex.zh: 反正你永遠不會知道。

ex.en: Anyway, let's get back to work.
ex.zh: 總之，我們回去工作吧。

anyway.en: used to change the subject or return to an earlier one

ex.en: Who are you, anyway?
ex.zh: 你到底是誰？

ex.en: Why are you here so early, anyway?
ex.zh: 話說你到底為什麼這麼早來？

anyway.en: used in questions to show you want the real answer

ex.en: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
ex.zh: 豐田公司宣布今年將裁員一千人。

ex.en: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
ex.zh: 首先，我想宣布幾項新規定。

ex.en: The engagement of Mr Rogers and Miss Smith was announced yesterday.
ex.zh: 羅傑斯先生和史密斯小姐昨天宣布訂婚。

ex.en: The pilot announced that we would land soon.
ex.zh: 機長廣播說我們即將降落。

ex.en: They announced the flight delay at the gate.
ex.zh: 他們在登機口廣播了班機延誤的消息。

announce.en: to say something aloud so that many people can hear it

ex.en: I don't know my father's annual income.
ex.zh: 我不知道我爸的年收入是多少。

ex.en: The annual meeting will be held in March.
ex.zh: 年度大會將於三月舉行。

ex.en: Our annual sales reached ten million dollars.
ex.zh: 我們的年銷售額達到一千萬元。

annual.en: happening once a year, or covering one year

ex.en: The school publishes an annual every June.
ex.zh: 學校每年六月出版一本年刊。

ex.en: Her photo appeared in the company annual.
ex.zh: 她的照片登在公司年刊上。

annual.en: a book or magazine published once a year

ex.en: Is there anybody who can drive a car?
ex.zh: 有人會開車嗎？

ex.en: He promised me that he won't tell anybody.
ex.zh: 他答應我不會告訴任何人。

ex.en: She can sing better than anybody else in her class.
ex.zh: 她唱歌比班上任何人都好。

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 航空專家詳細分析了統計資料。

ex.en: We want to analyze your urine.
ex.zh: 我們想化驗一下您的尿液。

ex.en: We need to analyze the sales data before the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們需要在開會前分析銷售資料。

analyze.en: to study something carefully to understand it or test it

ex.en: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
ex.zh: 暑假你有去哪裡玩嗎？

ex.en: I didn't go anywhere on my time off.
ex.zh: 我休假時哪裡都沒去。

ex.en: They looked everywhere for him, but couldn't find him anywhere.
ex.zh: 他們到處找他，卻哪裡都找不到。

anywhere.en: in or to any place, used in questions and negative sentences

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like.
ex.zh: 你想坐哪裡都可以。

ex.en: You can use this card anywhere in the world.
ex.zh: 這張卡在世界各地都能使用。

anywhere.en: in or to any place you choose

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: When I forgot my promise, he got really angry.
ex.zh: 我忘了自己答應過的事，他非常生氣。

angry.en: feeling strong displeasure toward someone or something

ex.en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我再也不吃肉了。

ex.en: He hurt his foot, he can't play soccer anymore.
ex.zh: 他腳受傷了，不能再踢足球了。

ex.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
ex.zh: 在這座城鎮，公共道德已經不再受到尊重。

anymore.en: not now, though it was true before

ex.en: She threw off her shoes and socks in anger.
ex.zh: 她氣得把鞋子和襪子甩掉。

ex.en: She couldn't hide her anger.
ex.zh: 她掩飾不住自己的怒氣。

anger.en: a strong feeling of being very annoyed

ex.en: His rude comments angered many customers.
ex.zh: 他無禮的言論激怒了許多顧客。

ex.en: The decision angered the staff.
ex.zh: 這個決定讓員工很不滿。

anger.en: to make someone feel very annoyed

ex.en: Tom is a financial analyst.
ex.zh: 湯姆是一名財務分析師。

ex.en: Analysts expect sales to rise next quarter.
ex.zh: 分析師預期下一季銷售額會上升。

ex.en: She works as a data analyst at a bank.
ex.zh: 她在銀行擔任資料分析師。

analyst.en: a person whose job is to study information and explain it

ex.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
ex.zh: 我預料會有麻煩。

ex.en: We do not anticipate their buying a new car.
ex.zh: 我們預料他們不會買新車。

ex.en: We anticipate strong sales this quarter.
ex.zh: 我們預期這一季銷售會很強勁。

anticipate.en: to expect that something will happen

ex.en: I've been anticipating his arrival.
ex.zh: 我一直期待著他的到來。

ex.en: It is the most anticipated movie of the year.
ex.zh: 這是今年最受期待的電影。

anticipate.en: to look forward to something with pleasure

ex.en: We should approach this problem from different angles.
ex.zh: 我們應該從不同角度看這個問題。

ex.en: Let's look at it from the customer's angle.
ex.zh: 我們從顧客的角度來看看。

angle.en: a way of thinking about a subject

ex.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
ex.zh: 90 度的角叫做直角。

ex.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
ex.zh: 這兩條線以直角相交。

ex.en: A hexagon has six angles and six sides.
ex.zh: 六邊形有六個角和六條邊。

angle.en: the shape made where two lines meet, measured in degrees

ex.en: He caused his parents a lot of anxiety.
ex.zh: 他讓父母非常擔心。

ex.en: The way to solve pre-exam anxiety is to start learning now.
ex.zh: 解決考前焦慮的方法就是現在開始讀書。

ex.en: Many people feel anxiety before a job interview.
ex.zh: 很多人在求職面試前會感到焦慮。

anxiety.en: a feeling of worry or fear about what may happen

ex.en: The CEO will make an important announcement tomorrow.
ex.zh: 執行長明天將宣布一項重要消息。

ex.en: Please listen carefully to the announcement.
ex.zh: 請仔細聆聽廣播公告。

ex.en: The announcement was posted on the company website.
ex.zh: 公告已經貼在公司網站上。

announcement.en: a public statement about something that has happened or will happen

ex.en: He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前一晚，他非常焦慮。

ex.en: We are anxious about our daughter's health.
ex.zh: 我們很擔心女兒的健康。

ex.en: I'm very anxious about my son's safety.
ex.zh: 我很擔心兒子的安全。

ex.en: I am anxious to visit Britain once again.
ex.zh: 我很渴望再去一趟英國。

ex.en: He is anxious to know the result.
ex.zh: 他急著想知道結果。

ex.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain the idea.
ex.zh: 老師用一個比喻來解釋這個概念。

ex.en: He drew an analogy between the brain and a computer.
ex.zh: 他把大腦比作電腦。

analogy.en: a comparison that shows how two things are alike

ex.en: Many families honor their ancestors during Tomb Sweeping Day.
ex.zh: 很多家庭在清明節祭拜祖先。

ex.en: My ancestors came from Fujian.
ex.zh: 我的祖先來自福建。

ancestor.en: a family member who lived long ago

ex.en: The vaccine helps your body produce antibodies.
ex.zh: 疫苗幫助身體產生抗體。

ex.en: The test checks for antibodies in your blood.
ex.zh: 這項檢測會檢查你血液中的抗體。

antibody.en: a substance the body makes to fight disease

ex.en: This temple dates back to antiquity.
ex.zh: 這座廟可以追溯到古代。

ex.en: The great thinkers of antiquity still influence us.
ex.zh: 古代的偉大思想家至今仍影響著我們。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of antiquities.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了大量古文物。

ex.en: Exporting antiquities is strictly controlled.
ex.zh: 古物出口受到嚴格管制。

antiquity.en: an object made in the very distant past

ex.en: The fund's annualized return was 6 percent.
ex.zh: 這檔基金的年化報酬率是百分之六。

ex.en: Analysts annualized the first-quarter sales figures.
ex.zh: 分析師把第一季的銷售數字換算成全年數字。

annualize.en: to change a figure so that it shows the amount for a whole year

ex.en: The position offers a salary of 900,000 dollars per annum.
ex.zh: 這個職位年薪九十萬元。

ex.en: The loan carries an interest rate of 3 percent per annum.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的年利率是百分之三。

ex.en: The fans waited in anticipation for the concert.
ex.zh: 歌迷們滿懷期待地等候演唱會。

ex.en: We hired more staff in anticipation of the holiday rush.
ex.zh: 我們預期連假會很忙，所以多聘了人手。

anticipation.en: a feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen

ex.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 湯姆從不忘記在結婚紀念日送花給太太。

ex.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.
ex.zh: 下個月是他們結婚五十週年，他們打算重新宣誓。

ex.en: Anniversaries are important.
ex.zh: 週年紀念日很重要。

anniversary.en: a day when you remember something that happened on the same date in an earlier year

ex.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my infection.
ex.zh: 醫生開了抗生素治療我的感染。

ex.en: Antibiotics don't work against viruses.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒無效。

antibiotic.en: a medicine that kills bacteria and cures infections

ex.en: This anthology includes poems from the last hundred years.
ex.zh: 這本選集收錄了近百年的詩作。

ex.en: She edited an anthology of short stories by young writers.
ex.zh: 她編輯了一本年輕作家的短篇小說選集。

anthology.en: a book containing pieces of writing by different authors

ex.en: The family returned to their ancestral home every spring.
ex.zh: 這家人每年春天都回到祖宅。

ex.en: They visited the ancestral graves during the festival.
ex.zh: 他們在節日期間去祭拜祖先的墳墓。

ancestral.en: belonging to or coming from your family members of long ago

ex.en: He told a funny anecdote about his first date.
ex.zh: 他講了一個關於他第一次約會的趣事。

ex.en: Grandpa's anecdotes always make the whole family laugh.
ex.zh: 爺爺講的趣聞總是逗得全家人哈哈大笑。

anecdote.en: a short interesting story about a real event or person

ex.en: She has been a news anchor for twenty years.
ex.zh: 她當新聞主播已經二十年了。

ex.en: The anchor read the breaking news.
ex.zh: 主播播報了這則快訊。

anchor.en: a person who presents the news on television

ex.en: The ship dropped anchor near the island.
ex.zh: 船在島附近下錨。

ex.en: They pulled up the anchor and sailed away.
ex.zh: 他們拉起錨，揚帆而去。

anchor.en: a heavy metal object that keeps a ship in one place

ex.en: I wish I could see the ancient world.
ex.zh: 真希望我能看看古代世界。

ex.en: Ancient people liked to tell stories of bravery.
ex.zh: 古人喜歡講英勇的故事。

ex.en: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
ex.zh: 大熊貓是一種存活至今的古老物種。

ancient.en: from a very long time ago

ancient.zh: ancient history：（口語）早就過去的事

ex.en: "Tom and Mary have broken up." "That's ancient history."
ex.zh: 「湯姆和瑪麗分手了。」「那是老早以前的事了。」

ex.en: Don't worry about that argument. It's ancient history.
ex.zh: 別在意那次吵架了，那都是陳年往事了。

ancient.en: something that happened so long ago that nobody cares about it now

ex.en: I'm an anthropology research student, and my topic is 'Chinese medicine in Britain'.
ex.zh: 我是人類學研究生，研究題目是「中醫在英國」。

ex.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures.
ex.zh: 人類學是研究人類社會與文化的學問。

anthropology.en: the study of human beings, their cultures and their history

ex.en: The annual report is available on our website.
ex.zh: 年度報告已刊登在我們的網站上。

ex.en: Shareholders received the annual report in April.
ex.zh: 股東在四月收到了年報。

annual report.en: a yearly document that tells how a company has done

ex.en: The team uses analytics to understand buying habits.
ex.zh: 團隊運用分析工具了解購買習慣。

ex.en: Web analytics show where visitors leave the site.
ex.zh: 網站分析資料顯示訪客在哪個頁面離開。

analytics.en: the study of data to find useful patterns, or the tools used for it

ex.en: The procedure will be performed under local anesthesia.
ex.zh: 這項處置會在局部麻醉下進行。

ex.en: The anesthesiologist explained the risks of general anesthesia.
ex.zh: 麻醉科醫師說明了全身麻醉的風險。

anesthesia.en: the use of drugs to stop you feeling pain during an operation

ex.en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅持認為自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
ex.zh: 我們必須仔細分析這起事故。

analysis.en: a careful study of something to understand its parts or causes

ex.en: It is difficult for me to answer the question.
ex.zh: 這個問題對我來講很難回答。

ex.en: You are not answering the question correctly.
ex.zh: 你答非所問。

answer.en: to say or write something in reply to a question

ex.en: Nobody answered the phone.
ex.zh: 沒有人接電話。

ex.en: Can you answer the door? I'm busy.
ex.zh: 你可以去應門嗎？我在忙。

answer.en: to pick up a ringing phone or open the door when someone calls or knocks

ex.en: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.
ex.zh: 考試後，我們對了一下寫的答案。

ex.en: Excuse me for not having answered your letter sooner.
ex.zh: 這麼晚才回信，真不好意思。

answer.en: something said or written in reply to a question, or the correct solution to a problem

ex.en: The scientists analysed the water samples in the lab.
ex.zh: 科學家們在實驗室分析水樣。

ex.en: We need to analyse the data before making a decision.
ex.zh: 我們需要先分析資料再做決定。

ex.en: She analyses sales figures every month.
ex.zh: 她每個月都會分析銷售數字。

ex.en: The painting shows an angel with white wings.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位有著白色翅膀的天使。

ex.en: The children dressed as angels for the school play.

ex.zh: 她對工作過時的想法惹惱了年輕員工。

ex.en: The money was donated anonymously.
ex.zh: 這筆錢是匿名捐贈的。

ex.en: Employees can anonymously report problems.
ex.zh: 員工可以匿名通報問題。

ex.en: Cheating is anathema to our coach.
ex.zh: 作弊是我們教練最痛恨的事。

ex.en: Loud music was anathema to the old librarian.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的音樂是那位老館員最受不了的東西。

ex.en: I would go anyplace with you.
ex.zh: 我願意跟你去任何地方。

ex.en: You can't park anyplace on this street.
ex.zh: 這條街上哪裡都不能停車。

ex.en: She let out an anguished cry when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時發出痛苦的哭喊。

ex.en: His anguished face showed how much he regretted it.
ex.zh: 他痛苦的神情顯示出他有多後悔。

ex.en: The book tells the story of a young anarchist who rejects all government.
ex.zh: 這本書講述一位拒絕一切政府的年輕無政府主義者的故事。

ex.en: The professor explained what an anarchist believes about authority.
ex.zh: 教授解釋了無政府主義者對權威的看法。

ex.en: Silence is the antithesis of a noisy party.
ex.zh: 安靜是熱鬧派對的對立面。

ex.en: His calm attitude was the antithesis of his brother's temper.
ex.zh: 他冷靜的態度和哥哥的壞脾氣正好相反。

ex.en: The two neighbors had an antagonistic relationship for years.
ex.zh: 這兩位鄰居多年來關係敵對。

ex.en: He was antagonistic toward anyone who disagreed with him.
ex.zh: 他對任何不同意他的人都懷有敵意。

ex.en: The annexation of the island was criticized by other countries.
ex.zh: 這座島嶼被吞併一事受到其他國家批評。

ex.en: The town's annexation by the larger city took place years ago.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮多年前就被較大的城市併入了。

ex.en: The storm threatened to annihilate the small fishing village.
ex.zh: 那場風暴有可能徹底摧毀這個小漁村。

ex.en: Our team annihilated the other side with a score of nine to zero.
ex.zh: 我們隊以九比零徹底擊潰了對手。

ex.en: The priest will anoint the child with oil.
ex.zh: 神父會用油為孩子行塗油禮。

ex.en: In the old story, a prophet came to anoint the new king.
ex.zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一位先知前來為新國王行塗油禮。

ex.en: Angling is a quiet hobby that many people enjoy on weekends.
ex.zh: 釣魚是一項許多人在週末享受的安靜嗜好。

ex.en: My grandfather took me angling at the lake when I was ten.
ex.zh: 我十歲時，爺爺帶我去湖邊釣魚。

ex.en: The war nearly led to the annihilation of the whole town.
ex.zh: 那場戰爭幾乎讓整座城鎮徹底毀滅。

ex.en: Scientists fear the annihilation of many species if forests disappear.
ex.zh: 科學家擔心森林消失後，許多物種會被徹底消滅。

ex.en: She added an anchovy to the pizza for extra flavor.
ex.zh: 她在披薩上加了一條鯷魚增添風味。

ex.en: The anchovy is a small, salty fish.
ex.zh: 鯷魚是一種小而鹹的魚。

ex.en: The lamp has an angled arm that you can adjust.
ex.zh: 這盞燈有可調整的傾斜燈臂。

ex.en: An angled roof lets the snow slide off.
ex.zh: 傾斜的屋頂能讓雪滑落。

ex.en: The antagonist of the novel is a cruel landlord.
ex.zh: 這本小說的反派是個殘酷的房東。

ex.en: Every good story needs a strong antagonist.
ex.zh: 每個好故事都需要一個強大的反派。

ex.en: In the sentence 'The book that I read', 'book' is the antecedent of 'that'.
ex.zh: 在「The book that I read」這句中，book 是 that 的先行詞。

ex.en: The court looked for an antecedent for this kind of case.
ex.zh: 法院尋找這類案件的前例。

ex.en: Antecedent events help explain what happened later.
ex.zh: 先前發生的事有助於解釋後來的狀況。

ex.en: Researchers studied the antecedent causes of the conflict.
ex.zh: 研究人員探討了這場衝突先前的成因。

ex.en: The hotel built a new annexe next to the main building.
ex.zh: 這間飯店在主建築旁蓋了新的附屬大樓。

ex.en: Classes are held in the school annexe this year.
ex.zh: 今年的課程在學校的附屬大樓上。

ex.en: The ship reached a safe anchorage before the storm.
ex.zh: 船在暴風雨來臨前抵達安全的錨地。

ex.en: There is a quiet anchorage behind the island.
ex.zh: 島後方有個安靜的停泊處。

ex.en: The bridge needs a strong anchorage for its cables.
ex.zh: 這座橋的纜索需要穩固的固定點。

ex.en: The engineer checked the anchorage of the steel poles.
ex.zh: 工程師檢查了鋼柱的固定情形。

ex.en: The butterfly moved its antennae to sense the air.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶擺動牠的觸角來感知空氣。

ex.en: Ants touch each other's antennae to share information.
ex.zh: 螞蟻互相碰觸觸角來傳遞訊息。

ex.en: The old building had several antennae on the roof.
ex.zh: 那棟老建築的屋頂上有好幾根天線。

ex.en: Engineers tested the antennae before the launch.
ex.zh: 工程師在發射前測試了這些天線。

ex.en: Antwerp is a large port city in Belgium.
ex.zh: 安特衛普是比利時的一座大港口城市。

ex.en: Many people visit Antwerp to see its old buildings and shops.
ex.zh: 許多人到安特衛普參觀古老的建築和商店。

ex.en: Hans Christian Andersen was a Danish author of fairy tales.
ex.zh: 漢斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生是丹麥的童話作家。

ex.en: Andersen wrote The Little Mermaid.
ex.zh: 安徒生寫了《小美人魚》。

ex.en: Anaerobic bacteria can live without oxygen.
ex.zh: 厭氧細菌不需要氧氣也能生存。

ex.en: Sprinting is an anaerobic exercise that uses short bursts of energy.
ex.zh: 短跑是一種利用短暫爆發力的無氧運動。

anglesey.zh: 安格爾西島（威爾士西北部的島嶼）

ex.en: Anglesey is an island off the northwest coast of Wales.
ex.zh: 安格爾西島是威爾士西北海岸外的一座島。

ex.en: You can reach Anglesey by crossing a bridge from the mainland.
ex.zh: 你可以從本土過橋前往安格爾西島。

ex.en: The garden was full of pink anemone flowers in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時花園裡開滿了粉紅色的銀蓮花。

ex.en: A small fish hid among the arms of the sea anemone.
ex.zh: 一條小魚躲在海葵的觸手之間。

ex.en: The patient was given general anaesthesia before the operation.
ex.zh: 病人在手術前接受了全身麻醉。

ex.en: Local anaesthesia numbs only a small part of the body.
ex.zh: 局部麻醉只會讓身體的一小部分失去知覺。

ex.en: She goes to an antenatal class every Tuesday evening.
ex.zh: 她每週二晚上都去上產前課程。

ex.en: Antenatal care helps keep both mother and baby healthy.
ex.zh: 產前照護能讓媽媽和寶寶都保持健康。

ex.en: The doctor said I was anemic and needed more iron.
ex.zh: 醫生說我貧血，需要多補充鐵質。

ex.en: She looked pale and anemic after the long illness.
ex.zh: 久病之後她看起來蒼白又貧血。

ex.en: The economy showed only anemic growth last year.
ex.zh: 去年經濟只呈現乏力的成長。

ex.en: The team gave an anemic performance in the second half.
ex.zh: 球隊在下半場表現得無精打采。

ex.en: The tour shows an antebellum mansion in the American South.
ex.zh: 這趟導覽會參觀美國南方一棟南北戰爭前的大宅。

ex.en: Many antebellum houses in the region have large white columns.
ex.zh: 這個地區許多戰前的老宅都有高大的白色圓柱。

ex.en: The baby looked angelic while she slept.
ex.zh: 寶寶睡著時看起來像天使一般。

ex.en: The choir sang with angelic voices.
ex.zh: 合唱團以天使般的歌聲演唱。

ex.en: His views are antithetical to mine.
ex.zh: 他的觀點和我的截然相反。

ex.en: Cheating is antithetical to the spirit of fair play.
ex.zh: 作弊與公平競爭的精神背道而馳。

ex.en: Don't antagonize the dog; it might bite you.
ex.zh: 別去惹那隻狗，牠可能會咬你。

ex.en: He antagonized his coworkers with constant complaints.
ex.zh: 他不停地抱怨，惹惱了同事。

ex.en: I don't want to antagonize my neighbors over a small fence.
ex.zh: 我不想為了一道小圍籬跟鄰居結怨。

ex.en: The lab uses an analyzer to test the blood samples.
ex.zh: 實驗室用分析儀檢驗血液樣本。

ex.en: The sound analyzer showed a problem with the engine.
ex.zh: 聲音分析器顯示引擎有問題。

ex.en: As a data analyzer, he spends his day studying numbers.
ex.zh: 身為數據分析者，他整天都在研究數字。

ex.en: A good analyzer looks at both sides of a problem.
ex.zh: 好的分析者會同時檢視問題的兩面。

ex.en: The nurse put antiseptic on the cut before covering it.
ex.zh: 護理師在包紮前先在傷口上塗了消毒劑。

ex.en: Keep a bottle of antiseptic in the first aid kit.
ex.zh: 急救箱裡要放一瓶消毒劑。

ex.en: This antiseptic cream helps prevent infection.
ex.zh: 這條殺菌藥膏有助於預防感染。

ex.en: The hospital room smelled strongly of antiseptic soap.
ex.zh: 醫院病房裡有濃濃的殺菌肥皂味。

ex.en: The blacksmith hit the hot iron on the anvil.
ex.zh: 鐵匠在鐵砧上敲打燒紅的鐵。

ex.en: A heavy anvil stood in the corner of the workshop.
ex.zh: 工作坊的角落放著一個沉重的鐵砧。

ex.en: Sparks flew from the anvil with every hammer blow.
ex.zh: 每一下鎚擊，鐵砧上都會迸出火花。

anachronism.zh: 時代錯誤；不合時宜的人事物

ex.en: A mobile phone in a medieval film would be an anachronism.
ex.zh: 中世紀電影裡出現手機就是時代錯誤。

ex.en: Some people think the old law is an anachronism.
ex.zh: 有些人認為那條舊法律已經不合時宜。

ex.en: The movie features an android that looks just like a human.
ex.zh: 這部電影有一個外表和人類一模一樣的人形機器人。

ex.en: The android learned to cook by watching videos.
ex.zh: 那個仿生人透過看影片學會了做菜。

ex.en: My new phone runs Android.
ex.zh: 我的新手機使用安卓系統。

ex.en: This app works on both Android and iPhone.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式在安卓和 iPhone 上都能用。

ex.en: She joined an antislavery society in the 1800s.
ex.zh: 她在十九世紀加入了一個反奴隸制的團體。

ex.en: The antislavery movement grew stronger over time.
ex.zh: 反奴隸制運動隨著時間愈發壯大。

ex.en: A smartphone in a movie about ancient Rome would be anachronistic.
ex.zh: 在古羅馬題材的電影裡出現智慧型手機就是時代錯置。

ex.en: Some people think the old rule is anachronistic today.
ex.zh: 有些人認為這條舊規定在今天已經不合時宜。

ex.en: The anesthesiologist checked my health before the surgery.
ex.zh: 麻醉科醫師在手術前檢查了我的健康狀況。

ex.en: An anesthesiologist stays with the patient throughout the operation.
ex.zh: 麻醉科醫師在整個手術過程中都陪在病人身邊。

ex.en: I use an antibacterial soap to wash my hands.
ex.zh: 我用抗菌肥皂洗手。

ex.en: The cloth has an antibacterial coating.
ex.zh: 這塊布有抗菌塗層。

ex.en: The dentist gave me a local anesthetic.
ex.zh: 牙醫幫我打了局部麻醉。

ex.en: The patient was under a general anesthetic during surgery.
ex.zh: 手術期間病人處於全身麻醉狀態。

ex.en: The doctor found an aneurysm in his brain scan.
ex.zh: 醫生在他的腦部掃描中發現了動脈瘤。

ex.en: An aneurysm can be dangerous if it bursts.
ex.zh: 動脈瘤一旦破裂可能很危險。

ex.en: The animator spent months drawing the cartoon character.
ex.zh: 動畫師花了好幾個月繪製那個卡通角色。

ex.en: She dreams of becoming an animator at a film studio.
ex.zh: 她夢想成為電影公司的動畫師。

ex.en: She took an antihistamine for her spring allergies.
ex.zh: 她吃了抗組織胺藥來緩解春季過敏。

ex.en: This antihistamine can make you feel sleepy.
ex.zh: 這種抗組織胺藥可能讓人想睡覺。

ex.en: Please annotate the text with your own notes.
ex.zh: 請在文章上寫下你自己的註解。

ex.en: The teacher asked us to annotate each poem we read.
ex.zh: 老師要求我們為讀過的每首詩加上註解。

ex.en: Try not to antagonise your neighbors over a small problem.
ex.zh: 別為了小問題惹惱你的鄰居。

ex.en: His rude comments antagonised the whole committee.
ex.zh: 他無禮的言論讓整個委員會都很反感。

ex.en: The doctor said his chest pain was caused by angina.
ex.zh: 醫生說他的胸痛是心絞痛引起的。

ex.en: People with angina should avoid heavy exercise.
ex.zh: 有心絞痛的人應避免劇烈運動。
